title: Encrypted DNS Discovery RFC 9463 Client Policy Work Item
summary: Add trace-owned client-side policy for consuming RFC 9463 encrypted DNS discovery data.
planned_changes:
- Add a pure client policy and immutable plan/endpoint value objects for RFC 9463 discovery consumption.
- Apply RFC 8106 source precedence when DHCP and Router Advertisement discovery data are both present.
- Prefer encrypted DNS over Do53 unless explicit local configuration says otherwise.
- Allow Do53 fallback only when encrypted DNS connection establishment fails and fallback is allowed.
- Model service-priority ordering, PKIX plus ADN certificate validation, and default versus explicit trust-anchor mode.
- Add focused positive and negative tests plus canonical xrefs.
verification_plan: Run the DNS project build, focused client-policy tests, core SpecTrace JSON validation, QUIC requirement coverage triage generation, diff hygiene, and the full solution test before commit.
out_of_scope: DHCP client state and Router Advertisement socket integration.
TLS certificate chain construction and RFC 6125 hostname matching internals.
Platform resolver installation and live Do53 traffic.
completion_notes: The DNS adapter now has a trace-owned RFC 9463 client policy floor that can consume DHCP and Router Advertisement DNR outputs.
